subject: Surveying and fitting around business operations
hook: Do we have to shut while you fit?
fb:
Do we have to shut while you fit? It's usually the first thing business owners ask us, and it's a fair worry.

Often, no. At survey we look at your trading hours, how people move through the building and which areas customers see. Because most of the cutting and assembly is done in our Hanley workshop, time on site is shorter. Noisy jobs can be booked out of hours, and bigger spaces can be fitted one zone at a time.

Occasionally a short closure is genuinely the quickest option, and if so we'll say so upfront. Want to talk it through for your premises? Ask us here:
https://superiofurniture.com/furniture-installation/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=craftsmanship-behind-the-finish&utm_content=day-315
gbp:
Do we have to close while you fit our new furniture? It's one of the most common questions we hear from businesses in Stoke-on-Trent.

Often, no. At survey we record your trading hours, access arrangements and which areas customers use, then plan the installation around them. Most cutting, edging, drilling and assembly is done in our own Hanley workshop, which keeps time on your premises short. Noisy tasks can be scheduled outside opening hours, and larger spaces can be fitted zone by zone.

If a brief closure would genuinely be quicker, we'll tell you at survey so you can decide. Ask us your question or arrange a consultation.
cta: Ask us how we'd plan it for your premises
